svg.title: TRAPPLE Order Management System
svg.desc: Selected work — TRAPPLE Order Management System: Capstone — for a private plastic packaging manufacturer. A customer storefront and an internal admin panel covering the whole quotation → order lifecycle, with real-time updates and lifecycle analytics, built with a small team over a year of agile iterations. Stack: Laravel 13, React 19, Inertia, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, Reverb. Mar 2026 → Nov 2026, private repository.
